dedupe_keys.name: uk government property estate buildings land occupation vacant space and disposals

description: This dataset describes the UK central government estate: land and property of government departments and their arm's-length bodies, including non-ministerial departments, executive agencies, non-departmental public bodies and special health authorities. It is published by the Cabinet Office under data transparency requirements and refreshed on the first of each month, as reported by the holding departments. Linked tables cover properties and contracts, buildings (ownership, location, floor area, usage, size and construction date), land, occupying organisations, disposals and vacant space, following the Government Property Data Standard. Coverage: mainly UK, with some overseas assets; commercially sensitive contract data and properties sensitive for national security are excluded, and a property can appear more than once when several bodies hold an interest. Access: six XLSX files, with the State of the Estate report. Licence: Open Government Licence v3.0; free. Caveats: data are as reported by departments and exclude sensitive sites. Simulation uses: exposure of public buildings to hazards, continuity planning for government services and estate rationalisation. Related records: the NHS hospital estates archive and the England planning application statistics.
